scope: Proposition 12.2 (Simultaneous representatives) of the manuscript “Filtered chromatic splitting at generic primes” (preprints/Filtered-chromatic-splitting-at-generic-primes-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 318 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f2aeefc98af1afcd), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 100. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are classes yi ∈ π1−2iD, 1 ≤ i ≤ n, represented by constant sphere-cochain classes whose integral Hurewicz images on Pn are αP n,i. For I = {i1 < · · · < ir}, put yI = yi1 · · · yir , y∅ = 1. These are represented by actual sphere-cochain classes with Hurewicz image αP n,i1 · · · αP n,ir . The class y∅ is the unit S → D.
